questions.stem: What happens to a population during the lag phase of a growth curve?

options.text: The population grows rapidly and exponentially
The population declines due to increased competition
The population remains stable at carrying capacity
The population grows slowly as organisms adjust to the new environment

questions.explanation: During the lag phase, the population grows slowly because organisms are adjusting to their new environment, there are few individuals to reproduce, and conditions may not yet be optimal. This is followed by the exponential growth phase.
